Title: Log in with valid credentials
Steps: Enter email; enter password; select Log in
Expected Result: Store page opens and shows the product catalog
Actual Result: Store page opened and catalog displayed

Title: Reject an incorrect password
Steps: Enter email; enter incorrect password; select Log in
Expected Result: Access is denied and a clear error is displayed

Title: Reject empty login fields
Steps: Leave both fields empty; select Log in
Expected Result: Access is denied and required information is requested

Title: Search by complete product name
Expected Result: Only Wireless Mouse is displayed

Title: Search is case-insensitive
Expected Result: Wireless Mouse is displayed

Title: Search with no matching product
Expected Result: A no-products message is displayed

Title: Filter by Electronics category
Expected Result: Only Electronics products are displayed

Title: Combine search and category filter
Expected Result: Only Notebook is displayed

Title: Add one product to an empty cart
Preconditions: User is logged in and cart is empty
Steps: Select Add to cart for Wireless Mouse
Expected Result: Cart shows Wireless Mouse with quantity 1

Title: Set quantity to minimum value 1
Expected Result: Quantity remains 1 and subtotal equals unit price

Title: Set quantity to maximum value 5
Expected Result: Quantity is accepted and subtotal is five times unit price

Title: Reject quantity below minimum
Expected Result: Value is rejected or reset to 1

Title: Reject quantity above maximum
Expected Result: Value is rejected or reset to 5

Title: Calculate subtotal for multiple units
Expected Result: Subtotal is $75.00

Title: Apply SAVE10 to eligible subtotal
Expected Result: Discount is $7.50 and total is $67.50

Title: Reject SAVE10 below $50 threshold
Expected Result: No discount is applied and eligibility message appears
Actual Result: No discount applied and message displayed

Title: Accept SAVE10 exactly at $50 threshold
Expected Result: Discount is $5.00 and total is $45.00
Actual Result: Code reported as ineligible and no discount applied

Title: Reject an invalid promotional code
Expected Result: No discount is applied and invalid-code message appears
Actual Result: No discount applied and message displayed

Title: Reject checkout with all fields empty
Expected Result: Order is not placed and required-field errors appear

Title: Reject malformed checkout email
Test Data: Name: Alex Tester; email: alex@; address: 1 Main St
Expected Result: Order is not placed and email validation error appears

Title: Complete checkout with valid data
Test Data: Name: Alex Tester; email: alex@example.com; address: 1 Main St
Expected Result: Confirmation is displayed and order is accepted

Title: Prevent checkout with an empty cart
Preconditions: User is logged in and cart is empty
Steps: Open checkout; enter valid data; submit
Expected Result: Order is not placed and empty-cart message appears
